directory_policies.notes.3: Degree background: A four-year bachelor degree or equivalent is expected; non-CS applicants may demonstrate the specified preparation through coursework or commensurate experience.
directory_policies.notes.4: GPA policy: 3.2/4 is recommended, not a verified hard minimum. Ordinary admission is separate from the Illinois-specific guaranteed-admission route.
directory_policies.notes.5: GRE policy: GRE is not required.
directory_policies.notes.6: Funding context: For first enrollment from Fall 2027, MCS becomes self-supporting; waiver-generating assistantships are unavailable except statutory waivers.

fact_summary: The shared MCS application page confirms degree preparation and optional GRE while distinguishing recommended GPA, special admission and new funding rules.
